name: Rice (Paddy)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan (Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg, Raigad, Thane), Eastern Vidarbha (Bhandara, Gondia, Chandrapur, Gadchiroli)
description: Primary staple cereal of coastal Maharashtra and Vidarbha lake districts. Grown under puddled flooded conditions or upland terraces.
waterRequirement: 1,000 - 1,400 mm; standing water layer (2-5 cm) during vegetative phase.
soilPreference: Heavy clay loam or silty clay soils with high water retention, pH 5.5 - 7.0.

growthStages.description: Raised bed seedling raising; 21-day seedlings transplanted to puddled field.
Active tiller production and crown root expansion in flooded mud.
Flag leaf emergence and panicle formation inside sheath; flowering begins.
Milky, dough, and mature golden grain hardening; field drained 10 days prior to sickle harvest.

commonDiseases.name: Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped diamond spots with grey center and dark brown margin on leaves and panicle neck.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Night temperatures 20-24°C with continuous drizzling rain and relative humidity >90%.

commonDiseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Water-soaked wavy lesions starting at leaf margins turning dull yellow with white bacterial crusts.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm temperatures (25-34°C) with strong wind-driven monsoon rains.

commonDiseases.name: Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Greenish-grey oval water-soaked blotches on leaf sheaths just above the waterline.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: High humidity (>95%) and heavy top-dressed nitrogen fertilizer.

generalPrevention: Use certified resistant varieties such as Karjat-3, Indrayani, PKV HMT, or Ratna.
Treat seed with Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/kg or Carbendazim @ 2g/kg.
Adopt Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) water management to suppress Brown Planthopper.
Avoid excessive basal urea; split nitrogen into 3 equal applications with potassium at panicle stage.

name: Wheat
maharashtraRegion: Western Maharashtra (Pune, Ahmednagar, Satara, Kolhapur), Vidarbha (Nagpur, Amravati), Khandesh (Jalgaon)
description: Premier winter cereal crop of India, grown extensively under irrigated black cotton soils in Maharashtra and alluvial plains of North India.
optimalTemp: 12°C - 25°C (cool nights during tillering, bright sunshine during grain fill)
waterRequirement: 400 - 500 mm across 4-6 critical irrigations (CRI, tillering, jointing, flowering, milking).
soilPreference: Deep, fertile well-drained clay loam or medium black cotton soil, pH 6.5 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: First whorl of crown roots forms below soil surface; paramount irrigation window.
Nodes elongate, vegetative tillers develop; canopy closes.
Earhead emerges from flag leaf boot; pollination occurs.
Starch accumulates; straw turns golden yellow; grains harden.

commonDiseases.name: Brown / Leaf Rust (Puccinia triticina)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Round to oval orange-brown powdery pustules scattered randomly across upper leaf blade.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm humid winter days (18-25°C) with morning dew.

commonDiseases.name: Yellow / Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Linear bright yellow stripes of powdery pustules arranged between leaf veins.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Cool winter temperatures (10-18°C) with persistent fog.

commonDiseases.name: Loose Smut (Ustilago tritici)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Entire earhead transformed into a loose sooty black mass of fungal spores.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Infected seeds germinating in cool moist soil.

generalPrevention: Sow in first fortnight of November to escape terminal heat in Central India.
Use certified high-yielding resistant varieties: Samadhan (NIAW-1994), Trimbak, or MACS-6222.
Treat seed with Carboxin + Thiram (Vitavax) @ 2.5g/kg for complete loose smut control.
Irrigate lightly at milk stage on calm windless days to prevent crop lodging.

name: Sorghum (Jowar)
maharashtraRegion: Solapur (Maldandi Capital of India), Marathwada (Latur, Beed, Osmanabad), Ahmednagar, Pune, Jalgaon
description: The golden heart of Maharashtra dryland agriculture. Drought-resilient C4 cereal famous for delicious pearl bhakri and high-quality livestock fodder (kadbi). Solapur Maldandi M 35-1 is world-renowned.
soilPreference: Medium to deep black clay soils (Vertisols) with moisture retention, pH 6.5 - 8.5.

growthStages.description: Rapid germination; shoot fly vulnerable period.
Dense node elongation; growing point converts into panicle.
Spike emerges from flag leaf collar; cross-pollination by wind.
Pearly grains fill; black layer at seed base marks physiological maturity.

commonDiseases.name: Grain Mold (Fusarium & Curvularia)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Pink, black, or grey discoloration on developing grain heads following rain.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Unseasonal wet spells during grain-filling stage.

commonDiseases.name: Downy Mildew (Peronosclerospora sorghi)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Vivid chlorotic yellow striping on leaves with downy white fungal growth on undersides.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: High humidity with cool night temperatures (20°C).

commonDiseases.name: Charcoal Rot (Macrophomina phaseolina)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Internal stalk shredding with tiny charcoal-like sclerotia causing lodging.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Post-flowering soil moisture stress and soil temperatures exceeding 35°C.

generalPrevention: Complete sowing within 10-15 days of monsoon onset to escape destructive shoot fly egg laying.
Treat seed with Imidacloprid 70 WS @ 7g/kg + Trichoderma @ 4g/kg.
Adopt famous resistant cultivars like Phule Yashoda, Maldandi M 35-1, or Parbhani Moti.
Intercrop with Pigeon pea (Tur) in a 2:1 ratio to interrupt stem borer life cycles.

name: Pearl Millet (Bajra)
maharashtraRegion: Ahmednagar, Nashik, Dhule, Jalgaon, Beed, Aurangabad, Pune rain-shadow belts
description: Climate-smart super-millet loaded with iron, zinc, and fiber. Thrives on light shallow soils under erratic rain-shadow monsoon belts.
soilPreference: Well-drained sandy loam, gravelly or shallow black soils, pH 6.0 - 8.0.

growthStages.description: Rapid crown tillering in dry soil conditions.
Cylindrical bristled spike developing inside sheath.
White feathery stigmas emerge first followed by yellow anthers; wind-pollinated.
Dense greyish-pearl grains harden; ready for harvesting.

commonDiseases.name: Downy Mildew / Green Ear (Sclerospora graminicola)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Floral spikes transform into twisted leafy green brush structures; chlorotic leaf stripes.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Humid overcast days with temperatures around 20-25°C.

commonDiseases.name: Ergot (Claviceps fusiformis)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Pinkish sticky honey-like liquid oozes from spikelets, later hardening into dark sclerotia.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Rainy, overcast days during protogynous flowering.

commonDiseases.name: Rust (Puccinia substriata)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Reddish-brown powdery pustules on both leaf surfaces causing premature drying.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm humid conditions after earhead emergence.

generalPrevention: Treat seed with Metalaxyl (Apron 35 SD) @ 6g/kg to immunize seedlings against downy mildew.
Dip seeds in 10% brine solution; skim off and destroy floating ergot sclerotia.
Plant bio-fortified high-yielding hybrids such as Dhanshakti, Phule Aadishakti, or GHB-538.

name: Maize (Corn)
maharashtraRegion: Khandesh (Jalgaon, Dhule), Nashik, Aurangabad, Kolhapur, Sangli
description: High-yielding versatile cereal cultivated for grain, poultry feed, green fodder, and industrial starch. Has seen massive expansion in Khandesh and Marathwada.
waterRequirement: 500 - 650 mm; critical water demand during tasseling and silking.
soilPreference: Deep, fertile, well-aerated sandy loam to clay loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Crown roots anchor; whorl leaves unfold rapidly.
Terminal tassel emerges shedding millions of airborne pollen grains.
Sticky silky strands emerge from ear shoot to capture falling pollen.
Kernels fill with starch; black layer forms at grain base at maturity.

commonDiseases.name: Maydis Leaf Blight (Bipolaris maydis)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Elongated tan lesions with brown borders on leaf blades.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm, humid conditions (20-30°C) with intermittent rain.

commonDiseases.name: Turcicum Leaf Blight (Exserohilum turcicum)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Long, elliptical grayish-green cigar-shaped necrotic lesions on foliage.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Cool, wet weather with heavy dews.

commonDiseases.name: Common Rust (Puccinia sorghi)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Golden-brown powdery pustules covering both leaf surfaces.

generalPrevention: Install pheromone traps @ 10/ha to detect Fall Armyworm moths immediately upon emergence.
Apply neem-based Azadirachtin 1500 ppm or Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2g/L into leaf whorls.
Ensure ridge-and-furrow planting to prevent root waterlogging.

name: Finger Millet (Ragi / Nachani)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan (Thane, Palghar, Raigad, Ratnagiri), Western Ghat hilly tribal belts of Nashik and Kolhapur
description: Ancient climate-resilient superfood millet celebrated for extraordinary calcium and amino acid content. Staple grain of Konkan tribal farmers and nutritious bhakri.
waterRequirement: 400 - 600 mm; tolerates high rainfall on sloped hill terrains without lodging.
soilPreference: Red sandy loam, gravelly laterite, or shallow hill soils, pH 5.0 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Tiny seeds raised on raised beds; transplanted to hill slopes.
Dense fibrous root system establishes in rocky hillside soil.
Digit-like whorl of 4 to 8 spicate fingers unfolds.
Seeds turn dark brown/russet; cut with sickle at full maturity.

commonDiseases.name: Ragi Blast (Pyricularia grisea)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions on leaf; choking black lesions on neck and fingers causing severe yield loss.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Cloudy, humid weather in Western Ghat hills during monsoon.

commonDiseases.name: Foot Rot / Wilt (Sclerotium rolfsii)
commonDiseases.symptoms: White mycelial fan at collar region with mustard-seed-like sclerotia.

generalPrevention: Use blast-tolerant university varieties like Phule Nachani, Dapoli-1, or GPU-28.
Treat seed with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg prior to nursery sowing.

name: Foxtail Millet
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada, Solapur, Ahmednagar drylands, Vidarbha
description: Fast-maturing, drought-tolerant nutrient-rich ancient millet with low glycemic index. Used for wholesome porridge, upma, and flour.
soilPreference: Light sandy loam to shallow black soils, well-draining.

growthStages.description: Quick emergence.
Compact bristled panicles forming.
Yellowish cylindrical drooping bristly spikes bloom.
Grains turn golden-yellow.

commonDiseases.name: Blast
commonDiseases.symptoms: Brown circular spots on leaves and panicles.

generalPrevention: Seed treatment with Thiram @ 3g/kg.

name: Barnyard Millet (Bhagar / Varai)
maharashtraRegion: Nashik (Trimbak), Konkan, tribal belt of Pune and Ahmednagar hills
description: Fastest-growing grain crop on earth (matures in 60 days). The revered staple grain for fasting (Upwas Bhagar) across Maharashtra.
waterRequirement: 300 - 450 mm; withstands severe drought as well as seasonal waterlogging.
soilPreference: Marginal, gravelly hill slopes and poor shallow soils, pH 5.5 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Rapid tillering.
Pyramidal panicle emerges.
Milky grains harden.

commonDiseases.name: Smut
commonDiseases.symptoms: Ovaries swollen into gall-like masses.

generalPrevention: Seed treatment with bio-agent Trichoderma viride.

name: Little Millet
maharashtraRegion: Tribal areas of Nandurbar, Gadchiroli, Chandrapur, Thane
description: Nutritious minor millet that grows on impoverished soils where almost no other cereal can yield.
soilPreference: Shallow gravelly red or lateritic soils.

growthStages.description: Fibrous rooting.
Loose open panicles.
Seeds turn straw-colored.

commonDiseases.name: Rust
commonDiseases.symptoms: Small orange spots.

generalPrevention: Sow with first soaking monsoon rains.

name: Kodo Millet
maharashtraRegion: Konkan hills, Vidarbha forest belts, Satpura ranges
description: Extremely hardy ancient millet rich in polyphenols and dietary fiber, cultivated since Indus Valley times.
soilPreference: Poor stony soils with minimal nutrition.

growthStages.description: Prostrate tillering.
Racemes with dark brown seeds.
Tough seed coat hardens.

commonDiseases.name: Head Smut
commonDiseases.symptoms: Dark powdery grains.

generalPrevention: Use certified seed.

name: Proso Millet
maharashtraRegion: Solapur, Nashik, Marathwada, Ahmednagar
description: Matures in only 60 to 75 days with lowest water requirement of any cereal grain.
soilPreference: Well-drained light loams.

growthStages.description: Fast canopy spread.
Drooping open panicle bloom.
Golden yellow grains harvested.

commonDiseases.name: Leaf Smut
commonDiseases.symptoms: Sooty streaks on leaf.

generalPrevention: Timely harvesting to prevent lodging.

name: Barley
maharashtraRegion: Western Maharashtra, Marathwada, North Maharashtra
description: Cool-season cereal used for nutritious sattu flour, malt, beverage production, and animal feed. Highly salt-tolerant.
soilPreference: Sandy to clay loam, tolerates salinity.

growthStages.description: Stiff erect tillers develop.
Bearded awned spikes emerge.
Golden straw and grain harvest.

commonDiseases.name: Covered Smut
commonDiseases.symptoms: Persistent membrane enclosing black spore mass.

generalPrevention: Seed treatment with Vitavax @ 2.5g/kg.

name: Oats
maharashtraRegion: Pune, Nashik, Satara dairy tracts (high fodder value)
description: Premium breakfast cereal and succulent dairy green fodder rich in beta-glucan and minerals.
soilPreference: Well-drained loam with moderate fertility.

growthStages.description: Leafy succulent shoots.
Loose spreading panicles.
Grain filling for milling or forage cut.

commonDiseases.name: Crown Rust
commonDiseases.symptoms: Orange pustules on upper leaves.

generalPrevention: Cut early at 50% flowering for highest protein fodder.

name: Basmati Rice
maharashtraRegion: Punjab, Haryana, Western UP, Tarai belt of India
description: The world-famous long-grain aromatic rice protected under Geographical Indication.
soilPreference: Deep alluvial clay loam.

growthStages.description: Slender aromatic tillers.
Fragrant panicles with long slender spikelets.
Grain elongation and aroma accumulation.

commonDiseases.name: Bacterial Blight
commonDiseases.symptoms: Water-soaked wavy leaf margins.

generalPrevention: Pusa Basmati 1121, 1509 varieties.

name: Indrayani Fragrant Rice
maharashtraRegion: Maval (Pune), Kolhapur, Satara, Nashik Western Ghats
description: Renowned fragrant, sticky medium-slender rice created by MPKV Rahuri, the heart of Maharashtrian cuisine.
soilPreference: Ghat valley fertile loams.

growthStages.description: Dense tillers with characteristic aroma.
Full drooping fragrant panicles.
Harvest when 85% grains turn straw golden.

commonDiseases.name: Blast
commonDiseases.symptoms: Diamond lesions.

generalPrevention: Adopt certified breeder seeds from MPKV.

name: Ambemohar Traditional Rice
maharashtraRegion: Bhor, Mulshi, Velhe, Maval foothills of Pune district
description: Traditional GI-tagged scented short-grain rice with aroma reminiscent of mango blossoms (आंबा मोहोर). Ideal for baby food, khichdi, and kheer.
soilPreference: High altitude red-lateritic valley soils.

growthStages.description: Slender slow vegetative growth.
Intense mango floral fragrance during morning anthesis.
Fragrant short grains harvested.

commonDiseases.name: Leaf Blast
commonDiseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions.

generalPrevention: Maintain pure organic cultivation.

name: Rye
maharashtraRegion: Himalayan foothills and experimental cool zones
description: Cold-hardy grain used for artisan bread, crispbread, and nutrient-dense cover crops.
soilPreference: Sandy and acidic soils.

growthStages.description: Deep root penetration.
Long awned spikes.
Hard slate-colored grains.

commonDiseases.name: Ergot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Purple-black sclerotia.

generalPrevention: Deep plowing to bury ergot sclerotia.

name: Durum Wheat (Bansi Wheat)
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada, Vidarbha, Western Maharashtra black soils
description: Hard vitreous amber grain with high protein and gluten strength, preferred for semolina (suji/rava), pasta, and daliya.
soilPreference: Deep black clay soils (Vertisols).

growthStages.description: Sturdy thick stems.
Heavy dense bearded heads.
Hard translucent amber kernels.

commonDiseases.name: Stem Rust
commonDiseases.symptoms: Dark brown pustules.

generalPrevention: Use MACS-2846, AKDW-2997-16 (Sharada) resistant varieties.

name: Pigeon Pea (Tur / Arhar)
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada (Latur is Asia's largest Tur dal trading hub), Vidarbha (Akola, Amravati), Khandesh
description: The foundation of Indian dal. Deep-rooted legume fixing nitrogen and enriching black soils; grown predominantly as intercrop with Soybean or Cotton.
waterRequirement: 600 - 800 mm; drought-hardy due to deep taproot.
soilPreference: Deep, well-drained black cotton soil or loam, pH 6.5 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Slow early growth while deep taproot establishes.
Profuse yellow blooms attract pollinators.
Green pods develop; pod borer vulnerable stage.
Pods turn dry brown; harvested with threshers.

commonDiseases.name: Fusarium Wilt (Fusarium udum)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Gradual wilting, purple bands on stems, vascular browning when stem is split.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Flowering stage during soil moisture fluctuations.

commonDiseases.name: Sterility Mosaic Disease (SMD)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Excessive bushiness, pale green mosaic leaves, complete lack of flowers; transmitted by eriophyid mites.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Dense canopies with high mite vector populations.

generalPrevention: Use wilt and SMD-resistant varieties like BSMR-736, BDN-711, or Maruti (ICP-8863).
Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4g/kg + Rhizobium culture.

name: Chickpea (Bengal Gram / Chana)
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada (Latur, Osmanabad), Western Maharashtra (Ahmednagar, Solapur), Vidarbha
description: Premier winter pulse crop of Maharashtra. Consumed as fresh green pods (Hurda/Harbhara ghaati), roasted gram, besan flour, and dry dal.
soilPreference: Deep, moisture-retentive black cotton soil with pH 6.0 - 8.0.

growthStages.description: Terminal bud nipping done at 25-30 days to stimulate heavy lateral branching.
Delicate pinkish or white flowers appear in leaf axils.
Pods swell containing 1-2 plump seeds.
Foliage turns golden brown; grains harden.

commonDiseases.name: Fusarium Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. ciceris)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Leaves drop, roots exhibit internal dark brown vascular discoloration.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm early winter soils or mid-season moisture stress.

commonDiseases.name: Ascochyta Blight
commonDiseases.symptoms: Circular lesions with concentric rings of pycnidia on leaves, stems, and pods.

generalPrevention: Plant wilt-resistant varieties like Digvijay, Vijay, Phule Vikram, or Jaki-9218.
Perform terminal nipping at 30 days to double pod-bearing branches.

name: Green Gram (Moong)
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada, Vidarbha, Jalgaon, Dhule, Ahmednagar
description: Quick-maturing (60-70 days) protein-rich pulse crop ideal for crop rotations and soil health regeneration.
soilPreference: Well-drained loam to clay loam.

growthStages.description: Rapid leaf canopy and root nodulation.
Yellow blossoms in clusters.
Black cylindrical pods ready for picking.

commonDiseases.name: Yellow Mosaic Virus (MYMV)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Irregular yellow and green patches on leaves; transmitted by whiteflies.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Hot dry weather with high whitefly activity.

commonDiseases.name: Powdery Mildew
commonDiseases.symptoms: White powdery coating on foliage.

generalPrevention: Grow MYMV-resistant varieties (BM-2002-1, BM-2003-2, Vaibhav).
Seed treatment with Imidacloprid @ 5g/kg.

name: Black Gram (Urad)
maharashtraRegion: Vidarbha (Nagpur, Wardha), Marathwada (Nanded, Latur), Khandesh
description: Indispensable pulse in Indian culinary traditions for papad, idli, vada, and dal makhani.
soilPreference: Medium to heavy black cotton soils with good drainage.

growthStages.description: Dense hairy stems and trifoliate leaves.
Bright yellow flowers.
Hairy pods turn black when ripe.

commonDiseases.name: Yellow Mosaic Virus
commonDiseases.symptoms: Bright golden yellow mottling.

commonDiseases.name: Cercospora Leaf Spot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Brown spots with reddish margins.

generalPrevention: Use resistant varieties like TAU-1, TPU-4, AKU-15.
Seed treatment with Trichoderma.

name: Soybean
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada (Latur, Nanded), Vidarbha (Amravati, Akola, Yavatmal, Nagpur), Western Maharashtra (Kolhapur, Sangli)
description: The golden bean that revolutionized Maharashtra agriculture. Miracle crop delivering 40% protein and 20% edible oil, supporting millions of rural livelihoods.
waterRequirement: 450 - 650 mm; highly sensitive to dry spells at pod-filling.
soilPreference: Deep, fertile well-drained black cotton soil, pH 6.5 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Emergence, unifoliate and trifoliate leaf expansion, root nodulation with Bradyrhizobium.
Tiny purple or white flowers open in leaf axils.
Pods elongate; critical moisture-sensitive phase.
Leaves yellow and drop; pods turn golden brown containing 2-3 round seeds.

commonDiseases.name: Soybean Rust (Phakopsora pachyrhizi)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Tiny brown to reddish-brown lesions with erupting volcanic pustules on leaf undersides.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Extended cloudiness, high relative humidity (>85%), temp 18-26°C.

commonDiseases.name: Charcoal Rot (Macrophomina phaseolina)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Sub-epidermal black specks (microsclerotia) causing premature plant death and stem splitting.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Post-flowering drought accompanied by high soil temp (>33°C).

commonDiseases.name: Collar Rot / Root Rot (Sclerotium rolfsii)
commonDiseases.symptoms: White fan-shaped fungal mycelium with brown mustard-like seeds at soil line.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Waterlogged soil conditions during seedling stage.

generalPrevention: Use high-yielding university varieties: JS-335, JS-9305, Phule Sangam (KDS-726), Phule Kimaya (KDS-753).
Inoculate seed with Bradyrhizobium japonicum + PSB culture @ 250g per 10kg seed.

name: Moth Bean (Matki)
maharashtraRegion: Ahmednagar, Solapur, Beed, Dhule, Jalgaon dry zones
description: Super-drought hardy pulse; soul of Maharashtra's beloved breakfast dish 'Misal Pav' when sprouted.
soilPreference: Light, sandy, gravelly marginal soils.

growthStages.description: Prostrate spreading ground cover.
Yellow blossoms.
Slender pods turn brown.

commonDiseases.name: Yellow Mosaic Virus
commonDiseases.symptoms: Yellowing of leaves.

generalPrevention: Use improved varieties like Phule Matki-15, RMO-40.

name: Cowpea (Chawli / Lobia)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan, Western Maharashtra, Marathwada, Vidarbha
description: Versatile dual-purpose crop grown for tender green vegetable pods, nutritious dry pulse, and green manure.
soilPreference: Adaptable to poor acid or alkaline soils.

growthStages.description: Vigorous twining or bush growth.
Long green hanging pods.
Dry grain pods harvested.

commonDiseases.name: Anthracnose
commonDiseases.symptoms: Sunken brown lesions on pods.

generalPrevention: Use Phule CP-05040, Konkan Safed varieties.

name: Lentil (Masoor)
maharashtraRegion: Vidarbha (Nagpur, Bhandara), Marathwada, Central India
description: Ancient quick-cooking protein-rich pulse cultivated in residual soil moisture after paddy.
soilPreference: Well-drained clay loam or alluvial soils.

growthStages.description: Delicate pinnate leaves.
Small bluish-white blossoms.
Flat pods holding 1-2 lens-shaped seeds.

commonDiseases.name: Rust
commonDiseases.symptoms: Uredial pustules on leaves.

generalPrevention: Seed treatment with Trichoderma.
Use KLS-218, JL-3 varieties.

name: Field Pea (Dry Vatana / Green Peas)
maharashtraRegion: Nashik, Pune, Satara, Ahmednagar cool winter pockets
description: Grown for sweet tender fresh green peas and sun-dried white/green vatana for famous street foods and curries.
soilPreference: Well-drained fertile loamy soil, pH 6.0 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Tendril-bearing climbing foliage.
White butterfly-like flowers; sweet pods swell.
Green pods handpicked or left to dry.

commonDiseases.name: Powdery Mildew (Erysiphe pisi)
commonDiseases.symptoms: White powdery coating covering leaves, stems, and pods.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Dry warm days and cool humid nights.

generalPrevention: Grow powdery mildew resistant varieties (Arkel, Azad P-1, Phule Priya).

name: Horse Gram (Kulthi / Kulith)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan (Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg), Western Ghats, Solapur, Ahmednagar
description: Nutritional powerhouse known for dissolving kidney stones and making soul-warming Konkani Pithla and soup.
soilPreference: Gravelly lateritic, red or impoverished hill soils.

growthStages.description: Dense low-creeping vine.
Small yellow blossoms.
Curved dry pods with flat hard seeds.

commonDiseases.name: Dry Root Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Bark shredded at collar.

generalPrevention: Use Dapoli-1, Sina varieties.

name: Kidney Bean (Rajma)
season: Rabi in Maharashtra / Kharif in Hills
maharashtraRegion: Western Maharashtra (Pune, Satara, Ahmednagar irrigated winter tracts), Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal
description: High-value protein pulse yielding plump red kidney beans with rich savory flavor.
soilPreference: Rich, fertile loamy soil with excellent drainage.

growthStages.description: Bush or pole type upright stems.
White or purple blooms.
Large kidney-shaped seeds fill.

commonDiseases.name: Bean Anthracnose
commonDiseases.symptoms: Sunken dark cankers on pods.

generalPrevention: Apply 100-120 kg N/ha since Rajma lacks active root nodulation.

name: Cluster Bean (Guar)
maharashtraRegion: Nashik, Pune, Ahmednagar, Marathwada, Rajasthan border tracts
description: Drought-hardy legume grown for delicious green vegetable clusters and industrial guar gum (galactomannan).
soilPreference: Sandy to loamy well-drained soils.

growthStages.description: Stiff upright branching.
Pods form in tight clusters at leaf nodes.
Tender vegetable pickings or seed drying.

commonDiseases.name: Bacterial Blight
commonDiseases.symptoms: V-shaped brown lesions on leaf margins.

generalPrevention: Grow Pusa Navbahar, Phule Gaurav.

name: Broad Bean (Fava Bean)
maharashtraRegion: Mahabaleshwar, Pune, Western Ghat plateaus, North India
description: Cool-season ancient legume producing large succulent nutrient-rich beans in thick leathery pods.
soilPreference: Heavy fertile clay loams.

growthStages.description: Square hollow stems and glaucous leaves.
White flowers with dark blotches.
Large thick pods.

commonDiseases.name: Chocolate Spot (Botrytis fabae)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Reddish-brown spots across leaves.

generalPrevention: Ensure wide row spacing (45 cm) for cross-ventilation.

name: Hyacinth Bean (Wal / Pavta)
localName: वाल / पावटा (Wal / Kadve Wal / Surti Wal)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan (Alibag Wal has GI status!), Pune, Satara, Western Maharashtra
description: Iconic pulse of Maharashtra coastal cuisine (Alibag Walachi Usal / Birde). Famous for distinct aromatic taste and high medicinal value.
waterRequirement: 350 - 450 mm; grown on residual moisture in rice fallows.
soilPreference: Medium black to coastal alluvium.

growthStages.description: Vigorous climbing vine trained on bunds or rice stubble.
White or purple fragrant flower racemes.
Broad flat pods harvested for fresh beans or dried.

commonDiseases.name: Yellow Mosaic
commonDiseases.symptoms: Golden leaf discoloration.

generalPrevention: Plant famous Konkan Wal, Phule Wal varieties.

name: French Bean (Snap Bean)
maharashtraRegion: Pune, Satara (Wai), Nashik, Kolhapur vegetable tracts
description: Crisp, tender stringless green pods highly prized in premium urban vegetable markets.
soilPreference: Friable sandy loam rich in organic compost, pH 6.0 - 6.8.

growthStages.description: Compact bush or climbing habit.
Self-pollinating blossoms.
Harvest pods when tender and snap easily before seeds bulge.

commonDiseases.name: Rust
commonDiseases.symptoms: Reddish pustules on leaves.

generalPrevention: Grow Contender, Phule Suyash varieties.

name: Winged Bean (Goa Bean)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan, Western Ghats, Goa border
description: All-edible miracle plant: tender four-winged pods, leaves, flowers, seeds, and tuberous roots are all protein-rich.
soilPreference: Moist laterite and alluvial soils.

growthStages.description: Strong vine requiring trellising.
Sky-blue edible flowers.
Four-angled frilled pods picked tender.

commonDiseases.name: Collar Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Damping off in waterlogged beds.

generalPrevention: Provide strong bamboo trellis support.

name: Lima Bean (Butter Bean)
maharashtraRegion: Mahabaleshwar, Panchgani, Satara cool hill tracts
description: Large buttery flat beans cultivated in cool Western Ghat hill slopes, famous specialty in Mahabaleshwar.
soilPreference: Deep rich mountain loams.

growthStages.description: Perennial or annual vigorous vine.
White or violet flowers.
Large flat pods with creamy butter beans.

commonDiseases.name: Downy Mildew
commonDiseases.symptoms: White fungal patches on pods.

generalPrevention: Harvest pods at mature green stage.

name: Rice Bean
maharashtraRegion: Tribal hill tracts of Vidarbha and Western Ghats, Northeast India
description: Climate-hardy underutilized legume immune to many diseases of common pulses, highly nutritious.
soilPreference: Acidic and poor mountain soils.

growthStages.description: Twining vine with yellow flowers.
Slender cylindrical pods.
Small oblong colored seeds.

commonDiseases.name: Cercospora Leaf Spot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Brown leaf spots.

generalPrevention: Grown naturally in tribal eco-farms.

name: Groundnut (Peanut)
maharashtraRegion: Western Maharashtra (Kolhapur, Satara, Sangli, Pune), Khandesh (Dhule, Jalgaon), Marathwada
description: Premier edible oilseed and protein food of Maharashtra. Geocarpic crop where flowers bloom above ground and pegs penetrate soil to form subterranean pods.
waterRequirement: 500 - 650 mm; critical water demand during flowering and peg penetration.
soilPreference: Light sandy loam, well-drained friable red/black soils rich in calcium, pH 6.0 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Rapid seedling emergence and lateral branching.
Yellow self-pollinated flowers; fertilized gynophore (peg) grows geotropically into soil.
Underground pod expansion; gypsum application ensures plump shells.
Internal pod shell displays dark brown reticulation; harvested by vine pullers.

commonDiseases.name: Tikka Disease / Leaf Spot (Cercospora arachidicola)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Circular dark brown spots with prominent yellow halos on upper leaf surface.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm, humid weather with prolonged leaf wetness (25-30°C).

commonDiseases.name: Groundnut Rust (Puccinia arachidis)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Orange-brown pustules on leaf undersides causing severe defoliation.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: High humidity and continuous cloudy monsoon spells.

generalPrevention: Apply Gypsum @ 500 kg/ha at pegging (40-45 days) to ensure calcium for pod shell formation.
Treat seed with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg + Imidacloprid @ 2ml/kg.
Use high-yielding university varieties: Phule Unnati, JL-24 (Phule Pragati), TAG-24, or TG-37A.

name: Mustard (Rapeseed / Sarson)
maharashtraRegion: Vidarbha, Khandesh, North Maharashtra, Rajasthan & MP border tracts
description: Important winter oilseed yielding pungent cooking oil and nutrient-dense oilcake for dairy cattle.
soilPreference: Light to heavy loam with good drainage, pH 6.0 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Broad radical leaves form dense ground rosette.
Central flower stalk bolts into golden yellow blossoms.
Slender beaked pods (siliquae) develop containing tiny round seeds.
Pods turn straw-yellow; harvested before shattering.

commonDiseases.name: White Rust (Albugo candida)
commonDiseases.symptoms: White porcelain-like blisters on leaf undersides and swollen staghead floral malformations.

commonDiseases.name: Alternaria Blight
commonDiseases.symptoms: Concentric dark brown target spots on leaves and siliquae.

generalPrevention: Sow early in October to escape severe aphid infestation in December-January.
Spray Oxydemeton-methyl or Dimethoate 30 EC @ 1ml/L at first aphid appearance on inflorescence.

name: Sunflower
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada (Beed, Latur, Osmanabad), Solapur, Ahmednagar, Vidarbha
description: Heliotropic oilseed with premium heart-healthy polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFA). Photo-insensitive crop suitable for any season in Maharashtra.
waterRequirement: 450 - 600 mm; critical at button stage, flowering, and seed development.
soilPreference: Deep, fertile black clay soils or fertile loams, pH 6.5 - 8.0.

growthStages.description: Rapid broad-leaf expansion and deep taproot development.
Inflorescence bud appears at stem apex; heliotropism active.
Ray florets and disk florets open; honeybee pollination essential.
Back of flower head turns lemon yellow; achenes harden.

commonDiseases.name: Alternaria Leaf Blight (Alternaria helianthi)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Dark brown circular spots coalescing into large necrotic blights.

commonDiseases.name: Necrosis Disease (Tobamovirus)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Systemic mosaic, leaf malformation, and necrotic streaks on stem and capitulum; thrips vector.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Hot dry spells with high thrips activity.

generalPrevention: Maintain 3-5 honeybee boxes per hectare to double pollination and prevent hollow seed formation.
Spray Mancozeb @ 2.5g/L or Propiconazole @ 1ml/L at initiation of Alternaria spots.

name: Safflower (Kardai)
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada (Osmanabad, Beed, Latur), Solapur, Ahmednagar, Western Maharashtra
description: Traditional drought-resilient spiny oilseed of Maharashtra black soils. Known for cold-pressed cardi-oil (high linoleic acid) and tender winter vegetable greens.
waterRequirement: 250 - 350 mm; extremely deep taproot extracts moisture from subsoil.
soilPreference: Deep black soils (Vertisols) with high water retention capacity.

growthStages.description: Slow prostrate growth while deep taproot penetrates 2-3 meters into subsoil.
Stiff spiny stems and branches form.
Vibrant orange-yellow florets bloom at branch tips.
White shiny achenes mature inside spiny involucral bracts.

commonDiseases.name: Alternaria Leaf Spot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Concentric brown spots with chlorotic haloes on leaves.

commonDiseases.name: Safflower Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Unilateral wilting and brown vascular discoloration.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Damp soil during vegetative rosette phase.

generalPrevention: Sow in late September or early October to escape aphid explosion in peak winter.
Use aphid-tolerant varieties like Phule Kusuma, Bhima, or NARI-6.

name: Sesame (Til)
maharashtraRegion: Khandesh (Jalgaon, Dhule), Vidarbha, Solapur, Marathwada
description: Queen of oilseeds; ancient oil-bearing plant rich in sesamin antioxidants and calcium. Sacred ingredient in Makar Sankranti Tilgul.
soilPreference: Well-drained sandy loam or light black soil, pH 6.0 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Erect branching and opposite leaves.
Bell-shaped white to pale pink flowers open in leaf axils.
Four-grooved erect capsules develop containing rows of seeds.
Bottom capsules turn yellow-brown; cut before dehiscence.

commonDiseases.name: Phyllody (Phytoplasma)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Floral parts transform into green leafy structures; plant becomes sterile witches' broom; leafhopper vector.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Continuous warm weather with leafhopper activity.

commonDiseases.name: Bacterial Blight
commonDiseases.symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots on foliage.

generalPrevention: Use varieties like Tapi (JLT-408), Phule Til-1, or RT-351.
Control leafhopper vector using Imidacloprid @ 3ml/10L to prevent incurable Phyllody.

name: Castor
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada, Vidarbha, Khandesh, Gujarat border tracts
description: High-value non-edible industrial oilseed producing ricinoleic acid used for high-grade aviation lubricants, cosmetics, and biodiesel.
soilPreference: Deep loam to gravelly light soil with good internal drainage.

growthStages.description: Large palmate leaves expand.
Monoecious flowers on terminal raceme.
Spiny capsules form on multiple spike orders.
Spikes picked as capsules turn yellowish-brown.

commonDiseases.name: Castor Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. ricini)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of plants with internal stem vascular browning.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Flowering stage during soil moisture stress.

commonDiseases.name: Botrytis Gray Mold
commonDiseases.symptoms: Woolly gray fungal mold rotting entire spikes during rain.

generalPrevention: Use wilt-resistant hybrids: DCH-177, GCH-7, or Phule Castor-1.
Install bird perches @ 25/ha to encourage birds feeding on semiloopers.

name: Linseed / Flaxseed (Javas)
maharashtraRegion: Vidarbha (Chandrapur, Bhandara, Nagpur), Marathwada, Central India
description: Ancient oilseed celebrated as modern superfood rich in Omega-3 (alpha-linolenic acid), lignans, and dietary fiber. Famous for Maharashtrian Javas Chutney.
soilPreference: Deep black moisture-retentive soils (Vertisols) or clay loams.

growthStages.description: Slender fibrous erect stems with linear leaves.
Sky-blue to violet flowers open in morning sunshine.
Globular bolls (capsules) develop containing 10 flat shiny seeds.
Bolls turn golden brown; rustle when shaken.

commonDiseases.name: Linseed Rust (Melampsora lini)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Bright orange-yellow uredial pustules on leaves and stems, later turning glossy black.

generalPrevention: Use rust-resistant university varieties: PKV NL-260, Meera, Sharda, or JLS-9.

name: Niger Seed (Karale)
maharashtraRegion: Tribal hill zones of Nashik (Igatpuri, Surgana), Nandurbar, Thane, Western Ghats
description: Hardy oilseed grown on impoverished tribal hill slopes. Core ingredient of authentic fiery Maharashtrian Karale Chutney.
waterRequirement: 300 - 450 mm; thrives on residual monsoon moisture.
soilPreference: Light gravelly laterite, poor stony or acidic soils.

growthStages.description: Dense semi-bush with yellow composite flowers.
Bright golden daisy-like heads attract bees.
Small black glossy seeds fill capitula.

commonDiseases.name: Cercospora Leaf Spot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Small brown spots on foliage.

generalPrevention: Use improved varieties: Phule Karale, IGP-76, RCR-18.

name: Coconut Palm (Copra & Oil)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan (Sindhudurg, Ratnagiri, Raigad, Palghar)
description: Tree of life (Kalpavriksha) producing pure copra oil for culinary, hair care, and wellness.
soilPreference: Coastal alluvium and lateritic soils.

growthStages.description: Nursery sprout establishment.
Crown of pinnate fronds.
Spadix blooms with male and female button nuts.
Husk browns; rich copra kernel.

commonDiseases.name: Bud Rot (Phytophthora palmivora)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Heart leaf withers and rots with foul smell.

generalPrevention: Apply Bordeaux paste to crown before monsoon.
Install pheromone traps for Red Palm Weevil.

name: Oil Palm
maharashtraRegion: Konkan coast, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Kerala
description: Highest yielding edible oil crop per hectare in the world; fresh fruit bunches processed for crude palm oil.
soilPreference: Deep, fertile friable loams.

growthStages.description: Massive frond whorls form.
Dense fruit bunches in leaf axils.
Bunches harvested when outer fruits turn reddish-orange.

commonDiseases.name: Basal Stem Rot (Ganoderma)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Yellowing fronds and brackets at trunk base.

generalPrevention: Field sanitation and root feeding with bio-control Trichoderma.

name: Cottonseed (Binola)
maharashtraRegion: Vidarbha, Marathwada, Khandesh
description: Massive source of edible washed cottonseed oil and protein-dense cattle feed cake across Maharashtra.
soilPreference: Deep black cotton soils.

growthStages.description: Seeds accumulate oil inside cotton bolls.
Lint separated from seed at ginning mills.

commonDiseases.name: Seed Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Discolored seeds.

generalPrevention: Delinting and thorough seed drying to 9% moisture.

name: Chia Seed
maharashtraRegion: Experimental trials in Pune, Ahmednagar, MP, Rajasthan
description: Ancient superfood packed with Omega-3 fatty acids, antioxidants, and mucilage fiber.
soilPreference: Sandy loam with excellent drainage.

growthStages.description: Opposite serrated leaves.
Purple or white spicate blossoms.
Tiny mottle-patterned seeds mature.

commonDiseases.name: Root Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Wilting in heavy clay.

generalPrevention: Plant on raised beds to guarantee zero standing water.

name: Taramira (Arugula Seed)
maharashtraRegion: North Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Punjab dry areas
description: Extremely drought and salt tolerant oilseed yielding pungent oil used for illumination, lubricating, and cattle.
soilPreference: Light sandy impoverished soils.

growthStages.description: Lobed aromatic leaves.
Creamy veined flowers.
Siliquae harvested.

commonDiseases.name: Downy Mildew
commonDiseases.symptoms: White patches.

generalPrevention: Grows with minimum moisture.

name: Canola (Low Erucic Mustard)
maharashtraRegion: Punjab, Haryana, experimental zones in Vidarbha
description: Specially bred low-erucic acid mustard yielding healthy cooking oil with high smoke point.
soilPreference: Fertile loam.

growthStages.description: Foliage canopy.
Yellow racemes.
Pods fill with dark round seeds.

commonDiseases.name: Sclerotinia Stem Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Bleached white stem lesions with black sclerotia inside.

generalPrevention: Foliar spray of Carbendazim at flowering if sclerotinia is prevalent.

name: Neem Seed (Oil & Karanj)
maharashtraRegion: Throughout Maharashtra & India
description: Priceless botanical biopesticide and soil nitrifying inhibitor (Neem Coated Urea) derived from dried wild nimboli.
soilPreference: All soil types.

growthStages.description: Fragrant white floral panicles.
Green drupes turn golden yellow and drop.

commonDiseases.name: Dieback
commonDiseases.symptoms: Twig drying.

generalPrevention: Collect freshly fallen yellow nimboli and sun-dry on clean tarpaulins.

name: Mahua Seed (Tora / Moha)
maharashtraRegion: Vidarbha forest tracts (Gadchiroli, Chandrapur, Gondia), Melghat
description: Forest oilseed yielding rich butter-like fat used for tribal cooking, soap making, and lighting.
soilPreference: Forest hills.

growthStages.description: Fleshy berries fall containing large brown oily seeds.

commonDiseases.name: Fungal Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Kernel decay.

generalPrevention: Sun-dry seeds thoroughly to prevent aflatoxin contamination.

name: Sugarcane
maharashtraRegion: Western Maharashtra (Kolhapur, Sangli, Pune, Satara, Ahmednagar), Marathwada
description: The lifeline of Maharashtra cooperative agro-economy and sugar capital of India. Massive biomass grass yielding crystalline sucrose, jaggery (gul), and bagasse bio-power.
waterRequirement: 1,500 - 2,500 mm; well-scheduled canal or drip irrigation essential.
soilPreference: Deep, well-drained fertile clay loam or medium black cotton soil with pH 6.5 - 8.0.

growthStages.description: Buds on 2-3 budded setts swell and push through furrow soil.
Heavy underground tillering creates 6-8 millable canes per clump.
Rapid internode elongation, cane thickening, and massive green foliage expansion.
Sugar synthesizes from top to bottom internodes; brix reaches 18-22%.

commonDiseases.name: Red Rot (Colletotrichum falcatum)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Third or fourth leaf from top yellows, canes lose turgidity, pith displays longitudinal red lesions with white cross-bands and alcohol smell.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Waterlogged fields following heavy monsoon rains.

commonDiseases.name: Sugarcane Smut (Sporisorium scitamineum)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Terminal growing point transforms into a long curved black whip-like structure covered in sooty spores.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Ratoon crops during hot dry spells.

commonDiseases.name: Grassy Shoot Disease (Phytoplasma)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Profuse thin chlorotic shoots emerging from base giving witches' broom appearance without cane formation.

generalPrevention: Use premier university varieties: Co-86032 (Nira), CoM-0265 (Phule 265), or MS-10001.
Treat seed setts in hot water or fungicide bath (Carbendazim @ 1g/L) before planting.
Adopt wide-row planting (4 to 5 feet) with drip fertigation to save 50% water and boost sucrose yields.
Apply bio-agent Metarhizium anisopliae @ 5 kg/ha to eradicate devastating White grubs.

name: Cotton (BT Kapas)
maharashtraRegion: Vidarbha (Yavatmal, Amravati, Akola, Wardha), Marathwada (Nanded, Jalna, Aurangabad), Khandesh (Jalgaon, Dhule)
description: The white gold of Maharashtra. Major fiber crop driving rural livelihoods across the black cotton soils of Vidarbha, Khandesh, and Marathwada.
optimalTemp: 22°C - 34°C (warm days, plenty of sunshine during boll bursting)
waterRequirement: 600 - 850 mm; sensitive to waterlogging as well as prolonged drought at flowering.
soilPreference: Deep, moisture-retentive black cotton soil (Vertisols) with good drainage, pH 6.5 - 8.0.

growthStages.description: Deep taproot development; pyramidal branching; floral buds (squares) appear in leaf axils.
Creamy-white flowers bloom, turn pinkish-purple on day two after pollination; young bolls set.
Bolls expand accumulating fiber and oil; pink bollworm vulnerable period.
Mature bolls dehisce exposing fluffy white lint; handpicked in 3-4 pickings.

commonDiseases.name: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Upward or downward leaf curling, vein thickening, and leafy enations on underside of leaves; whitefly vector.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Hot weather with high whitefly activity.

commonDiseases.name: Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot (Xanthomonas citri pv. malvacearum)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots bounded by veins on leaves, black arm lesions on branches, water-soaked spots on bolls.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm humid conditions with stormy wind-driven rains.

commonDiseases.name: Grey Mildew / Dahiya Disease (Ramularia areola)
commonDiseases.symptoms: White powdery frost-like angular patches on lower leaf surface leading to premature leaf shedding.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Post-monsoon cool nights with high morning humidity.

generalPrevention: Install pheromone traps @ 5/ha for early Pink bollworm monitoring and @ 20/ha for mass trapping.
Spray Flonicamid 50 WG @ 3g/10L for effective control of sucking pests (jassids and thrips).
Avoid late-season extension of cotton crop beyond January to break the life cycle of Pink bollworm.
Plant non-Bt border rows to delay pest resistance development.

name: Desi Cotton (Tree Cotton)
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada, Vidarbha rainfed dry belts
description: Hardy indigenous cotton immune to sucking pests, drought, and requiring minimal chemical inputs. Highly valued for medical cotton and denim.
soilPreference: Medium to shallow black soils.

growthStages.description: Sturdy bush.
Yellow blossoms with red centers.
Fluffy lint bolls.

commonDiseases.name: Fusarium Wilt
commonDiseases.symptoms: Yellowing and wilting.

generalPrevention: Use varieties: PA-255 (Turab), PA-402, PKV DH-1.

name: Tobacco
maharashtraRegion: Kolhapur (Nipani border belt), Sangli, Gujarat border tracts
description: Commercial leaf crop processed for bidi and chewing tobacco. Kolhapur-Nipani tract is famous across India for high-nicotine bidi tobacco.
soilPreference: Light sandy loam to well-drained medium black soil.

growthStages.description: Tiny seeds raised in nursery; transplanted.
Rapid broad leaf growth; terminal flower head nipped (topped) to direct energy to leaves.
Axillary suckers removed; leaves turn thick leathery yellow-green with brown spangles.
Leaves cut and sun-cured or pit-cured on ground.

commonDiseases.name: Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Mottling of light and dark green patches, leaf blistering and distortion.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Mechanical contact during topping and desuckering.

commonDiseases.name: Black Shank (Phytophthora nicotianae)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Black discoloration of stem base and discing of pith.

generalPrevention: Wash hands with soap and trisodium phosphate before handling plants to prevent TMV spread.
Use recommended bidi varieties: Anand-119, Vedaganga-1, or Bhagyashree.

name: Jute (Golden Fiber)
maharashtraRegion: Eastern India (West Bengal, Bihar, Assam), Konkan river basins
description: The biodegradable golden fiber of India used for burlap bags, geotextiles, rope, and eco-packaging.
soilPreference: Alluvial silt loam near river deltas.

growthStages.description: Unbranched straight tall cylindrical stems reaching 3-4 meters.
Yellow small blossoms; harvested at 50% flowering for best fiber quality.
Bundles submerged in slow-moving water for 15-20 days for microbial pectin breakdown.

commonDiseases.name: Stem Rot (Macrophomina phaseolina)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Brown to black lesions on stem causing breaking.

generalPrevention: Harvest promptly at small pod stage to secure fine silky fiber tensile strength.

name: Mesta (Ambadi / Roselle)
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada, Vidarbha, Khandesh
description: Multipurpose commercial crop: tough bast fibers extracted from stems; tender tangy leaves cooked as Maharashtra's famous culinary 'Ambadi Bhaji'.
soilPreference: Medium to light soils.

growthStages.description: Tender red/green stalks; culinary leaf picking.
Large yellow flowers with crimson center; fleshy calyx forms.
Stalks cut and retted for twine and rope.

commonDiseases.name: Foot & Stem Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Dark rotting at base.

generalPrevention: Use varieties: AMV-5, AS-73-CP-560.

name: Sunn Hemp (San)
maharashtraRegion: Throughout Maharashtra (Western Maharashtra, Vidarbha, Marathwada)
description: Premier fast-growing green manure and fiber crop. Fixes 100 kg nitrogen per hectare and decomposes in 45 days to rejuvenate tired soils.
soilPreference: Adaptable to all well-drained soils.

growthStages.description: Vigorous thick growth suppressing all weeds.
Ploughed into moist soil at succulent flowering stage.
Left to mature if tough cordage fiber is required.

commonDiseases.name: Vascular Wilt
commonDiseases.symptoms: Drooping leaves.

generalPrevention: Plough in at 50% bloom for maximum organic nitrogen synthesis.

name: Mulberry (Reshim / Tuti)
maharashtraRegion: Western Maharashtra (Pune, Satara, Sangli, Solapur), Marathwada (Beed, Osmanabad)
description: Commercial agro-enterprise feeding silkworms (Bombyx mori) to harvest lustrous white bivoltine silk cocoons. Provides continuous monthly farm cash flow.
soilPreference: Deep, fertile well-drained loams, pH 6.5 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Canes pruned close to ground to stimulate fresh succulent shoots.
Rapid growth of protein-dense glossy green leaves.
Canes harvested daily and fed to voracious 5th instar silkworms in rearing sheds.

commonDiseases.name: Leaf Spot (Cercospora moricola)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Brown circular spots on foliage reducing silkworm palatability.

commonDiseases.name: Powdery Mildew (Phyllactinia corylea)
commonDiseases.symptoms: White powdery patches on leaf undersides.

commonPests: Mealybug (Tukra disease causing bunched leaf tips)
generalPrevention: Use high-yielding university varieties: V-1 (Victory-1), S-36, or G-4.
Release predator beetles Cryptolaemus montrouzieri @ 250 adults/acre to eradicate Tukra mealybugs.

name: Betel Vine (Paanvel)
maharashtraRegion: Sangli, Solapur, Pune, Raigad, Vasai, Amaravati
description: High-value perennial shade-loving creeper yielding glossy heart-shaped aromatic betel leaves for traditional Vidya paan and digestive use.
waterRequirement: Frequent light misting; shade conservatories (bareja) required.
soilPreference: Rich, fertile well-aerated sandy loam with heavy compost, pH 7.0 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Trained on live supports of Shevri or Sesbania inside thatched shade huts.
Mature lustrous green leaves carefully snapped with fingernail.

commonDiseases.name: Foot Rot / Phytophthora Wilt
commonDiseases.symptoms: Sudden leaf wilting and blackening of stem internodes.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Monsoon moisture stagnation inside humid bareja.

commonDiseases.name: Anthracnose / Leaf Spot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Dark circular spots with yellow halo.

generalPrevention: Drench root base with Trichoderma harzianum and apply 1% Bordeaux mixture on lower vines.
Ensure optimal ditch drainage around thatched conservatories.

name: Natural Rubber
maharashtraRegion: Kerala, Coastal Konkan (Sindhudurg trials), South India
description: Strategic commercial plantation tree tapped for liquid milky latex, the raw material for vehicle tires and industrial goods.
soilPreference: Deep, well-drained acidic lateritic soils.

growthStages.description: Grafted sapling reaches 50 cm trunk girth.
Controlled spiral cut on bark; latex collected in coconut shell cups every alternate morning.

commonDiseases.name: Abnormal Leaf Fall (Phytophthora)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Extensive defoliation during southwest monsoon.

commonDiseases.name: Pink Disease (Corticium salmonicolor)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Pink crust on trunk forks.

generalPrevention: Aerial or tractor spraying of copper oxychloride in oil before monsoon onset.

name: Lemongrass (Oil Distillation)
maharashtraRegion: Western Maharashtra, Vidarbha, Marathwada wasteland tracts
description: Hardy aromatic grass distilled for pure citral-rich essential oil used in perfumes, soaps, vitamin A synthesis, and herbal tea.
soilPreference: Poor, gravelly, eroded soils or reclaimed wastelands.

growthStages.description: Rooted slips planted on ridges.
Foliage cut 10 cm above ground.
Regrowth cut and loaded into steam distillation stills.

commonDiseases.name: Rust (Puccinia nakanishikii)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Brown pustules on foliage.

generalPrevention: Distill freshly wilted grass within 24 hours of cutting.

name: Sisal (Ghaypat)
maharashtraRegion: Dry rain-shadow belts of Solapur, Ahmednagar, Marathwada bunds
description: Extremely drought-resilient succulent providing industrial leaf fibers for marine ropes, dartboards, and agricultural boundary fencing.
soilPreference: Arid rocky calcareous soils.

growthStages.description: Thick sword-like spiny leaves expand.
Lower leaves harvested for mechanical decortication.
Giant 6-meter flower pole emerges; plant dies leaving bulbils.

commonDiseases.name: Leaf Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Soft rot in waterlogged soils.

generalPrevention: Plant along field boundaries to prevent soil erosion and keep stray livestock out.

name: Bamboo (Green Gold)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan (Sindhudurg Manga bamboo), Vidarbha forests, Western Ghats
description: Wonder woody grass harvested for furniture, construction scaffolding, paper pulp, ethanol, and charcoal. Fast-growing carbon sink.
soilPreference: Well-drained hill soils and riverbanks.

growthStages.description: Rhizome spread and shoot emergence.
Canes mature; 3-year-old culms selectively harvested annually.

commonDiseases.name: Culm Rot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Discolored shoots.

generalPrevention: Treat felled bamboo with Borax-Boric acid solution to prevent wood borers.

name: True Indigo
maharashtraRegion: Historical regions of Central and South India
description: Historic natural blue dye plant cultivated for organic textile artisans and herbal hair color formulations.
soilPreference: Sandy loam with good drainage.

growthStages.description: Pinnate leaves expand.
Cut at early flowering when indican glucoside peaks.

commonDiseases.name: Leaf Blight
commonDiseases.symptoms: Brown patches.

generalPrevention: Steep freshly cut foliage in water tanks for microbial dye fermentation.
